name: Manatsu no Yo no Yume
source:
In search of their next adventure, Luffy and the crew set sail once again.
Along the way, they make a stop at a port—only to find it’s on his island!..

※This is an 18+ adult visual novel based on the One Piece series, currently serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump.
The pairing featured is Sanji × Zoro.
The story is set after the events of the Arabasta Arc.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040607004440fw_/http://www92.sakura.ne.jp/~pb/gamesetumei.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
为了寻找下一次冒险，路飞和船员们再次扬帆起航。
一路上，他们在一个港口停下来，却发现它就在他的岛上！..

※这是一部以海贼王系列为基础的18岁以上成人视觉小说，目前在周刊少年JUMP上连载。
特色配对是山治×索隆。
故事发生在阿拉巴斯塔篇事件之后。

[翻译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040607004440fw_/http://www92.sakura.ne.jp/~pb/gamesetumei.html]官方网站[/url]]
